items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I had one other gig like that. Nat and Buddy Johnson's band, and Sarah.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was playing with Clark Terry's band -- Grady Tate and Earl Hines was on the bill with the great Buddy Johnson, soloist. And Bobby Troop was on the -- this bill. Bobby is from Pennsylvania, incidently, he's from Lancaster, Pennsylvania. And we had all of the local -- he's the hero, you know, there. But -- That must have been the late '60s.
